Awards & Achievements

Kai Shing awarded the "Most Popular Employer - Property Management" by JobsDB

Kai Shing Management Services Limited (Kai Shing) places great importance on employees' physical and mental well-being and actively promotes a healthy workplace culture, enabling employees to maintain a work-life balance. With the outstanding strategies in human resources management, Kai Shing has successfully clinched the "Most Popular Employer - Property Management" in "The Hong Kong HR Awards 2023/24" organised by JobsDB among peers. The award has been long recognized as one of the top human resources events in Hong Kong, aiming to honor individuals and organisations for their outstanding achievements in the field of human resources. The judging panel consists of human resources directors and leaders from different sectors; the results have also partially determined by public voting which has gained widespread recognition across the industry.

This accolade further affirms Kai Shing's management approach of focusing on people. Kai Shing has consistently invested resources in nurturing talents and launched "KS NOVA", a talent development programme to provide customized on-the-job training for management colleagues to enhance their leadership capabilities in various aspects, fostering their innovative thinking and adaptability. Meanwhile, Kai Shing has always cared about employees' physical and mental well-being by actively promoting a healthy workplace culture. To help employees maintain good work-life balance, the company has also established a "Staff Activities Committee" to collect employee preferences and organise diverse activities to meet the needs of colleagues at different age groups and family positions. In order to further promote a healthy workplace culture, the company has also organised numerous activities in recent years with a focus on physical and mental well-being, including "KS Wellness Festival" and "Wellness Month", providing employees with comprehensive health information and support to cater different aspects of their physical or mental needs. For instance, the company constantly distributes fruits and healthy drinks, hosts wellness seminars and shares health tips via online learning platform etc., to raise employee awareness of physical and mental health. Kai Shing believes that happy employees can bring joy to customers. Under a pleasant and proactive work environment where employees can work together seamlessly and efficiently, they are more likely to provide exceptional services, resulting in increased customer satisfaction and happiness.

Kai Shing is honored to receive recognition from the industry and the public for its efforts in human resources management. We will continue to establish a harmonious, healthy and sustainable working environment where our team can thrive together with the company.
